alkylation_concentration.evidence: The supernatant was discarded and the pellet re-suspended in iodoacetamide (IAA; 50 μL 100mM) and incubated at room temperature for 30 minutes.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The urea was then diluted out by addition of 250μL water and 5μL of 0.2 μg/μL sequencing grade modified trypsin and incubated overnight (20 hours) at 37oC with agitation.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Survey scans were acquired at a resolution of 70,000 at 200m/z and the 15 most abundant precursors were selected for HCD fragmentation.
